FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 S.Ramsey@lindco.com.au

E.Mayer@lindco.com.au

Employee training session

June 4, 11:21 A.M.
Dear Ms. Mayer,

I received a memo telling me to attend a customer service training session next Saturday. That is outside my normal working hours. As you are my manager, could you please tell me more about this training and why I’m being asked to take it?

Thanks,

Sheila Ramsey
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are Sheila Ramsey’s manager. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ONE reason.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Sheila, Lời chào
The Saturday training session lasts all day and will teach you about our four new products (thông tin 1). We want you to be able to address customer service issues related to the new products, so you need to learn more about them (lý do). If you cannot attend the Saturday training, you will not be able to work with the new products until you are trained (thông tin 2). - Thông tin 1: Khóa training thứ 7 kéo dài cả ngày và sẽ dạy bạn về 4 sản phẩm mới - Lý do: Chúng tôi muốn bạn biết xử lý các tính huống về dịch vụ khách hàng liên quan tới sản phẩm mới - Thông tin 2: Nếu bạn không tham gia buổi training bạn sẽ không thể làm việc với sản phẩm mới
Best, E.Mayer Ký tên

questions.question: Some university programs require students to complete an internship before graduating. What are the advantages and disadvantages of having this requirement? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài Requiring students to complete an internship before graduating has several advantages and disadvantages. Since it's a requirement, the university helps students get the internships, which can be challenging to do by yourself. Also, this requirement will give students job experience while they're still deciding what career they want. However, internships take time away from classes and may make it impossible for students to take classes at all. Trình bày các luận điểm: - Lợi ích 1: Trường đại học sẽ giúp sinh viên tìm chỗ thực tập - Lợi ích 2: Cho trải nghiệm làm việc - Bất lợi: Không có thời gian để học  
Thân bài 1 (Lợi ích 1: trường đại học sẽ giúp tìm các nơi thực tập) First, requiring students to complete an internship is a good idea because it means that the university probably helps students find internships. My friend went to a university that had this requirement, and he got an internship easily. Other friends went to schools that didn't have an office set up to help them find internships, and they were not able to find internships on their own. - Ví dụ: Bạn tôi học ở một trường đại học có yêu cầu như vậy và anh ý có được chỗ thực tập dễ dàng. Các người bạn khác học những trường khác mà không có văn phòng hỗ trợ tìm thực tập thì phải tự tìm chỗ rất khó khăn
Thân bài 2 (Lợi ích 2: trải nghiệm làm việc) Another reason it is good to require students to complete. an internship is that it gives students job experience. A friend of mine did an internship with a marketing firm and realized that she did not really enjoy working in that field. Instead, she said she would rather do sales, since she likes working with the sales team's better. After this experience, she went to graduate school and focused on sales, instead of marketing. - Ví dụ: Một người bạn của tôi thực tập ở doanh nghiệp marketing và nhận ra cô ấy không thật sự thích ngành đó, mà cô ấy thích làm sale hơn. Sau trải nghiệm đó cô ấy tốt nghiệp và tập trung vào mảng sale.
Thân bài 3 (Bất lợi: không có thời gian học) There are also disadvantages to requiring internships. Many internships make interns work 9-5, Monday- Friday. This means that students can only take night classes, but they may be too tired to even do that. Other internships may not take up as much time, but they still pull students away from their classes and their study time. - Phân tích: Nhiều chỗ bắt làm từ 9-5h, T2-T7. Điều đó có nghĩa là sinh viên chỉ học được lớp buổi tối, nhưng họ có thể quá mệt để làm được đó. Một vài chỗ thực tập không bắt làm nhiều thời gian nhưng vẫn khiến sinh viên không tập trung vào các lớp học và thời gian học tập.
Kết bài For the above reasons, I believe there are both advantages and disadvantages to requiring internships for university students. Perhaps universities can be very selective about the companies and schools that they include in their internship programs. Universities could also limit the amount of time that students spend interning. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
